justification: Image A shows small schematic, stick-like reddish figures (apparently human, possibly with weapons) scattered irregularly on a rock surface, while Image B shows a single large, detailed winged anthropomorphic/eagle-headed figure carved in relief with elaborate feather and garment detailing flanked by rosette-and-tree border patterns. The only broad correspondence is the presence of a humanoid figure, but the form, proportions, composition, surrounding motifs, and rendering style are entirely different, so there is no evidence of a shared iconographic scheme.'
